description: Hybrid newsletter-first platform with Supabase Magic Link auth. Designed for Incheon Science High School first, but with extensible architecture for future multi-community support. Verification via Alumni DB matching + Quiz.

authentication.flow: Email → Magic Link → Onboarding (Alumni DB match required) → Optional Quiz → Verified Badge
authentication.userTable: profiles table linked to auth.users via id FK

verification.current: Alumni DB matching (name + graduation_class) + School Quiz
verification.future: Pluggable verification providers per community (invite code, email domain, admin approval, etc.)
verification.note: Alumni DB match is required during onboarding for MVP. Quiz is optional for 'Verified' badge.

extensibility.concept: Single community for MVP, but data model supports future multi-tenant expansion
extensibility.profileFields: community_id field reserved for future use (nullable, defaults to 'incheon-science-high')

modify: User entity → Profile entity linked to Supabase Auth

userStories.title: Migrate to Supabase Auth
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to replace custom auth with Supabase Auth Magic Link so that users can log in without passwords.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove password field from User/Profile entity
Create profiles table: id (= auth.users.id), email, name, graduation_class, is_verified, is_admin, alumni_id (FK nullable), created_at
Configure Supabase Auth for Magic Link in dashboard
Set up email templates for Magic Link
Migration script for existing users if any

userStories.title: Magic Link Login Flow
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to log in via Magic Link so that I can access the platform without a password.
acceptanceCriteria: Login page at /login with email input only
Sends Magic Link via Supabase Auth signInWithOtp
Callback page at /auth/callback handles Supabase redirect
On first login (no profile), redirect to /onboarding
On returning login (has profile), redirect to home

userStories.title: Onboarding with Alumni DB Verification
userStories.description: As a new user after first Magic Link login, I want to verify my identity against Alumni DB and create my profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Onboarding page at /onboarding (requires auth, no profile yet)
Step 2: AlumniMatchingService checks against Alumni DB
If match found: create profile linked to alumni_id, proceed to optional quiz
If no match: show error, cannot proceed (contact admin for manual addition)
Creates profile in profiles table linked to auth.users.id

userStories.title: Optional Quiz Verification
userStories.description: As a logged-in user with profile, I want to optionally take the alumni quiz so that I can become a 'Verified Alumni' with extra privileges.
acceptanceCriteria: Quiz prompt shown after onboarding (skippable with 'Later' button)
Quiz page at /verify reuses existing quiz system
On pass: sets is_verified = true on profile
Shows 'Verified Alumni' badge on profile and directory
On fail: can retry (existing retry logic)
Skip option available - can verify later from settings

userStories.title: Auth Middleware & Session Management
userStories.description: As a developer, I want proper auth middleware so that routes can check authentication and verification status.
acceptanceCriteria: Helper: getCurrentUser() returns { user, profile } or null
Helper: requireAuth() middleware for protected API routes
Helper: requireVerified() middleware for verified-only routes
Helper: requireAdmin() middleware for admin routes

userStories.title: Newsletter Domain Model
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to define Newsletter and NewsletterSection domain entities.
acceptanceCriteria: Newsletter entity with id, edition, title, sections, status (draft/published), publishedAt, createdAt
NewsletterSection entity with id, type (alumni_in_media/member_announcements/industry_trends), title, content, order
NewsletterStatus value object with draft/published states
Entities follow existing DDD patterns (toPrimitives, factory methods)
Unit tests for entity creation and validation

userStories.title: Newsletter Subscription Domain Model
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to define Subscription entity that supports both anonymous and authenticated subscribers.
acceptanceCriteria: Subscription entity with id, email (required), userId (optional), status (active/unsubscribed), subscribedAt, unsubscribedAt
SubscriptionPreferences value object with optOutFromScraping, contentPreferences array
Methods: subscribe(), unsubscribe(), linkToUser(userId), updatePreferences(), isActive()

userStories.title: Newsletter Database Schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to create Supabase migrations for newsletter tables.
acceptanceCriteria: newsletters table with edition (unique), title, status, published_at, created_at
newsletter_sections table with newsletter_id (FK), type, title, content, display_order
newsletter_subscriptions table with email (unique), user_id (FK nullable to auth.users), status, preferences_json, timestamps
